brief: Converts a decimal number, given as text, into its binary form such as 0b1010.101.
detail: It is the converter behind ToBinaryForm of stzNumber. Build one with new stzDecimalToBinary("10.625") or StzDecimalToBinary("10.625"); the number must be a text, and a number or a text that is not a decimal raises an error. The integer part is converted through the engine and the fractional part by repeated doubling, cut at 19 binary digits. A negative number is converted as its positive twin with a minus sign in front. StzBinaryNumber hands the result to a stzBinaryNumber.
